description: Complete Phase 1 Task 1.1 (Python bindings) by reconciling reality with the doc and cleaning up the binding crate. The crate already compiles (the doc's claim of 35 PyO3 errors is stale), so the remaining work is: eliminate the 3 compiler warnings in xplainit-python and the unused-import warning in xplainit-node, and add a small Rust unit test asserting the callback -> event-store recording path works so the binding's core behaviour is covered by cargo test. This makes `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass, as required by CONTRIBUTING.md. Depends on FEAT-002 (do warning cleanup after the behavioural fix so signatures are final).
steps: In xplainit-python/src/lib.rs, silence the two deprecated-signature warnings by adding `#[pyo3(signature = (verbosity=None))]` to get_explanations and print_explanations (keeping current default behaviour).

In xplainit-python/src/lib.rs, resolve the unused `backend` variable warning on the AutoTracer::new pyclass constructor (prefix with underscore, or actually use it if wiring the Rust AutoTracer to a passed backend makes sense - underscore is acceptable since the Python-side AutoTracer is the one actually used).
In xplainit-node/src/lib.rs remove the unused `use std::collections::HashMap;` import.

Repair the pre-existing broken secondary test at xplainit-python/test_automatic_tracing.py so it runs successfully with the fixed auto-tracer. It currently fails at import: `from python.tracer import XplainitTracer` (the submodule python/tracer.py exports AutoTracer, not XplainitTracer), and it uses `with python_tracer:` as a context manager plus `python_tracer.enable()/.disable()` which AutoTracer supports as start()/stop() but not the context-manager protocol. Fix the import to use AutoTracer (or add an XplainitTracer alias in python/tracer.py exports consistent with __init__.py), and adjust the usage (use start()/stop(); either add __enter__/__exit__ to AutoTracer or rewrite the context-manager section to start/stop explicitly). It must import xplainit correctly and run to completion showing captured events > 0. Keep changes minimal and consistent with the primary test.

Add a Rust unit test in xplainit-python/src/tracer.rs (or a #[cfg(test)] block in lib.rs) that constructs a PythonTracer (enabled), calls record_function_enter and record_function_exit, and asserts get_events_json() / get_stats() reflect the recorded events (count > 0). This exercises the real recording code path (not a static assertion) so it would fail if recording were broken.
Run `cargo build --release` and confirm zero warnings for xplainit-python and xplainit-node.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `cargo fmt --all` then `cargo test` and confirm all green including the new binding test.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo build --release` produces no warnings from xplainit-python or xplainit-node.
A new cargo test exercises PythonTracer record_* -> get_events/get_stats and passes; it would fail if event recording were removed.
The secondary test xplainit-python/test_automatic_tracing.py imports and runs to completion showing captured events > 0.
`cargo test` all green; `python test_automatic_tracing.py` still 3/3 and decorator test still passes (no regression).
verification: cd xplainit-python && source ../.venv/bin/activate && maturin develop --release && cd .. && python test_automatic_tracing.py
findings:
Completed. CHANGES:
1) xplainit-python/src/lib.rs: added `#[pyo3(signature = (verbosity=None))]` to get_explanations and print_explanations (silences the two deprecated-signature warnings). Renamed the AutoTracer::new `backend` param to `_backend` (with matching `#[pyo3(signature = (_backend=None))]`) to resolve the unused-variable warning.
2) xplainit-node/src/lib.rs: removed the unused `use std::collections::HashMap;` import.
3) xplainit-python/src/tracer.rs: added two #[cfg(test)] unit tests exercising the real record path - `test_record_events_flow_through_to_store` records a FunctionEnter+FunctionExit on an ENABLED PythonTracer and asserts get_events_json() parses to exactly 2 events (count>0, contains "add") and get_stats() reports "Events captured: 2"; `test_disabled_tracer_records_nothing` proves a disabled tracer records nothing. These fail if recording is removed (behavioural, not static). Also changed the pre-existing `parse_python_value("3.14")` assertion literal to 2.5 to avoid clippy::approx_constant (PI) - the value 3.14 was a clippy blocker unrelated to correctness.
4) xplainit-python/python/tracer.py: added `enable()`/`disable()` aliases (call start()/stop()), `__enter__`/`__exit__` context-manager protocol on AutoTracer, and a module-level `XplainitTracer = AutoTracer` alias exported in __all__ (consistent with python/__init__.py which already re-exports AutoTracer as XplainitTracer). This repairs xplainit-python/test_automatic_tracing.py which imported XplainitTracer and used enable()/disable() plus `with python_tracer:`.

CLIPPY NOTE (deviation from planner's assumption): planner's empirical finding said only the 4 build warnings blocked clippy, but `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` was NEVER clean on base - it also emitted 10 `useless_conversion` (PyErr->PyErr) errors from pyo3 0.22 macro-generated PyResult wrappers, plus the approx_constant on 3.14. An `#[allow]` on the impl block does NOT suppress the macro-generated wrappers, so I added a crate-level `#![allow(clippy::useless_conversion)]` inner attribute at the top of xplainit-python/src/lib.rs (documented with a comment). The approx_constant was fixed by changing the test literal (see #3).

FMT NOTE: did NOT run `cargo fmt --all` - the repo is not fmt-clean at baseline (running it reformats 30+ pre-existing files across every crate and even errors on a trailing-whitespace line in xplainit-core/src/explainer.rs). To keep the change focused on FEAT-003, my edits follow the surrounding local style (the files use 4-space-indented blank lines throughout); I reverted an accidental whole-workspace reformat. Pre-existing fmt drift is out of scope for this feature.

VERIFICATION (all green):
- `cargo build --release`: no warnings from xplainit-python or xplainit-node.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`: exit 0.
- `cargo test`: 99 passed, 0 failed (xplainit-c 5, xplainit-core lib 76, core integration 9, xplainit-java 1, xplainit-node 1, xplainit-python lib 6 [was 4, +2 new], core doc-test 1). New tests pass.
- After `maturin develop --release` from xplainit-python/: repo-root `python test_automatic_tracing.py` => Passed 3/3 (100%); `python xplainit-python/test_decorators.py` => ALL DECORATOR TESTS PASSED; `python xplainit-python/test_automatic_tracing.py` (the repaired secondary) => imports cleanly and runs to completion with events > 0 (add=2 events, factorial recursion, exception, and context-manager all capturing; final stats 'Events captured: 2').
